decision: Recorded before the new balanced sensitivity runs, after seeing the equal-cap pilot. Not confirmatory preregistration.
rounding: integer largest remainders, lexicographic stratum ties

comparison.rule: Report all three draws, including unchanged or worse stability. Do not redraw seeds, remove flights or tune allocation after seeing these outcomes.

interpretation: Lower maximum weights or higher Kish ESS describe allocation, not proven outcome-specific precision. Three-draw ranges are descriptive, not physical-model uncertainty intervals.
scope: Laboratory sensitivity only. Do not change held-out validation, production data, frozen release, public site or January release preparation.
